basic_info.description: Fabulous 2-bed/2-bathroom (one plus office) on quiet block of San Jose Avenue.  Residence 8 is unique in its high ceilings, split floor plan with massive island kitchen and walk-out deck to private deeded garden space.  Primary suite is fit for a resort with double vanities, luxurious walk-in shower and built-out closet system. Underfloor heating, fully integrated kitchen appliances and designer-finishes throughout.
